scope: 4D local quadratic gravity about Minkowski with real finite scalar and massive-spin-2 poles under standard perturbative Feynman/Hilbert-space physical-state interpretation
failure_reason: the massive spin-2 pole has residue opposite to the ordinary graviton; in the frozen standard physical-state interpretation this violates the RQIR positivity/unitarity requirement
scope_guardrail: does not apply automatically to curvature-squared EFT below cutoff, pure R+R^2, or modified ghost prescriptions such as fakeon/Lee-Wick/modified-inner-product approaches
